newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanon's Sibline cement co secures $57.5 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: Lebanon's Sibline cement co secures $57.5 mln loan.

text.p: Societe des Ciments de Sibline, Lebanon's third biggest cement company, signed a $57.5 million syndicated loan agreement with six Lebanese banks to finance its expansion, a company official said on Monday.
The six-year loan carries annual interest of 12 percent with two years grace, he said.
Most of the loan will be converted next year into bonds with which Sibline will repay the syndicate, the official added.

Banque de la Mediterranee headed the syndicate which signed the agreement on Friday. The other banks were Bank of Beirut and the Arab Countries, Banque Audi, Banque Saradar, Arab Bank, and Banque Libanaise pour le Commerce.

On February 1 Sibline issued a $20-million convertible bond which with the new loan will finance a new production line raising capacity to 1.2 million tonnes per year from 400,000 tonnes, Zuhayri added.
The expansion project, which began on February 1, will last 20 months, he said.
